title: Expected input cost of the randomized NAND tree
statement: For every input $x\in\{-1,1\}^2$, the expected number of queried coordinates in the specified randomized decision tree is $\bigl(c(x_0)+c(x_1)\bigr)/2$, where $c(1)=1$ and $c(-1)=2$.
